text.content:
A Silent alcove, quiet enough that it's clearly been used as a waypoint by more than one previous expedition.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: the Bone Choir never got the burial it was owed, and it intends to make everyone still breathing understand why that matters.

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: the Bone Choir has been rebuilding an army out of everyone who's ever died on this floor - including, eventually, the party.

Substory beat: A single still-living prisoner has been kept alive for decades as a witness to something the Bone Choir doesn't want forgotten - or remembered.
